newsitem.title: UK: ABN AMRO recommends sell Mirror, buy Utd News.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO recommends sell Mirror, buy Utd News.

text.p: Broker ABN AMRO Hoare Govett said on Friday it was re-emphasising its "sell" recommendation on Mirror Group Plc and recommending a switch into United News & Media Plc.
"Valuing media companies is all about looking at cash," said an analyst at the brokerage.

"Why have Mirror, which is valued at 8.6 times cash flow, when you could have United at 8.2 times when United will deliver compound growth in cash flow over the next five years of 14 percent while Mirror will struggle to do half that," he said.
BZW earlier upgraded Mirror from a "sell" to a "hold".
Mirror shares were up 0.5p at 210p by 1137 GMT while United had added 9p to 749.5p.
Mirror released its 1996 results on Thursday, boosting pre-tax profit by 6.6 percent to 82.2 million pounds, excluding exceptional items.
United weighed in with its results on Friday. Its pre-tax profit rose 12 percent to 290.2 million pounds in what it called an "excellent" first year following a merger with MAI.
The ABN AMRO analyst said the United News presentation on Friday morning had been "very positive" and added that the brokerage maintained its "buy" recommendation on the stock.
